question: Which of the following administrative units was introduced during the reign of Shahjahan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chakla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• During the reign of Shahjahan, the administrative unit called **Chakla** was introduced.
 
• Chakla was a subdivision of a province (Subah) in the Mughal administrative system.
 
• Each Chakla was further divided into smaller units called **Paraganas**.
 
• The Chakla system aimed to streamline revenue collection and local governance.
 
• This administrative reform helped in better management and control of the vast Mughal Empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subah**

 
 
• Subah was the largest administrative division in the Mughal Empire, similar to a province.
 
• Each Subah was governed by a Subahdar who was responsible for law and order, as well as revenue collection.
 
 
 
• **Paragana**
 
 
• Paragana was a smaller administrative unit within a Chakla.
 
• It comprised several villages and was managed by local officials for tax collection and judicial matters.
 
 
 
• **Mahals**
 
 
• Mahals referred to revenue circles or estates within a Paragana.
 
• They were the basic units for land revenue assessment and collection.
 
 
 
• **Zamindars**
 
 
• Zamindars were landowners who collected taxes from the peasants and paid a portion to the Mughal administration.
 
• They played a crucial role in the revenue system of the Mughal Empire.
